purpose: Feed the scroll-fade text fragment the glyph UV the native vertex program actually writes.

replacements.basis: The translated primary program stores pa[1].x (a_TextureCoordinate.x) in o2.w and pa[1].y in o3.x and never writes o3.y, so V67's vTexCoord = o3.xy sampled (v, 0). 2026-11-16 V113 run on SimonDesk drew My Vehicle rows as solid glyph boxes, consistent with a constant atlas sample.
